How to get these drops

  1. Link your Cyberpunk 2077 account to Twitch — Connect your account ↗, or via Twitch Settings → Connections. One-time setup.
  2. Watch an eligible stream — Watch any Cyberpunk 2077 stream on Twitch ↗ that shows the Drops Enabled tag. Progress fills automatically while you watch. Make sure you're logged into Twitch.
  3. Claim your drop — When the progress bar fills, a notification appears in chat. Click it, or go to twitch.tv/drops/inventory ↗ to claim. You have ~24 hours before it expires.
  4. Receive in-game — Rewards appear in your Cyberpunk 2077 account within a few minutes. Restart the game if they don't show up.

Frequently Asked Questions

What Cyberpunk 2077 Twitch Drops are available?

Cyberpunk 2077 has 2 Twitch Drop rewards: Short-Fuse Neon, The Mox. Active campaigns end November 19, 2026.

How do I get Cyberpunk 2077 Twitch Drops?

To earn Cyberpunk 2077 Twitch Drops: link your Twitch account to your Cyberpunk 2077 game account, watch an eligible stream for the required time, then claim your drops at twitch.tv/drops/inventory. Drops expire if unclaimed after the campaign ends.

When do the Cyberpunk 2077 Twitch Drop campaigns end?

The current Cyberpunk 2077 Twitch Drop campaigns end on November 19, 2026. Watch and claim before then — unclaimed drops expire with the campaign.

Which channels should I watch for Cyberpunk 2077 Twitch Drops?

Watch any Twitch channel streaming Cyberpunk 2077 while the campaign is active.
